A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TFLA/mLSTM research. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching across renumbering and relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original DCLM language-modeling results, gate and normalization experiments, and GPU runtime and memory measurements in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original language-modeling experiments, ablations, and GPU benchmarks in Section 5 and the appendices.

M1.justification: New Appendix A.3 specifies proposed adaptations through gate reparameterization and, for DeltaNet, precomputing U and W and materializing transformed values V*=U-WC. These extensions explicitly await implementation; the evaluated TFLA algorithm and mLSTM variants remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same DCLM language-modeling coverage, synthetic transfer-behavior inputs, and kernel benchmark scenarios. The additional discussion of other RNN architectures does not introduce evaluated tasks or datasets.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Llama-style Transformers, the JAX reference, FlashAttention implementations, Mamba/Mamba 2, GLA variants, and LightningAttention2. Appendix A.3 discusses possible applications rather than adding evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training budgets, context lengths, hyperparameters, hardware, metrics, and benchmark input configurations remain unchanged in Section 5 and Appendix E. The added discussion of state-storage precision clarifies existing implementations rather than reporting a changed setting.

E4.justification: The gate-initialization, trainable-gate, normalization, numerical-validation, head-dimension, and runtime/memory analyses are retained. New Section 5.3 summarizes analyses already present in v1's Appendices F and G.

E5.justification: Both versions report median benchmark runtime over 30 iterations after 10 warmup iterations in Appendix E.3. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched experimental tables and plots retain their results. For example, Table 6 reports the same fixed/learnable-gate perplexities: 21.23/20.95 for mLSTMexp and 21.24/21.04 for mLSTMsig. Figure renumbering and the new runtime summary introduce no new measured outcomes.

T1.justification: Appendix A.3 adds DeltaNet's chunkwise equations and an algebraic compatibility argument using V*=U-WC to recover TFLA's Equation (20). Existing mLSTM derivations and FLOP/runtime mathematics are retained; the gate-index clarification preserves v1's explicit summation.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain two-level sequence parallelism, the faster sigmoid-gated mLSTM, and improved initialization informed by transfer analysis. Added arithmetic-intensity emphasis reflects findings already present in v1, while the main performance claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix E.3 newly explains Simple GLA's speed partly through its missing input gate and bfloat16 states versus TFLA's float32 states. Appendix A.3 makes applicability conditions explicit and states that implementations for the additional architectures remain future work.

D1.justification: v2 adds PyTorch gate-computation code in Figure 7, clarifies indexing and comparator state precision, and corrects Table 1's backward-kernel launch grids to match the existing partitioning description. The new listing contains an incomplete assertion line. Software versions, training details, and code-access information are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: Appendix A.3 expands specific connections to Retention, Gated Retention, Mamba 2, and DeltaNet. References on memory bottlenecks and recent state-tracking RNNs are added, while Qin et al. (2023) is removed. The original FlashAttention/FLA positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: v2 refines introductory and technical explanations, adds Appendix A.3, and expands Appendix B.2. Section 5.3 brings the existing appendix runtime conclusions into the main narrative. Most prose and the overall section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds gate diagrams in Figures 2 and 8 and a code listing in Figure 7, lightly revises the tiling diagram, and corrects Table 17's caption from per-chunk to full-sequence counts. Existing experimental displays are retained with renumbering and page reflow.

improvement.justification: Corrected launch-grid documentation, clearer gate illustrations, and the explicit applicability argument improve technical clarity. Section 5.3 also makes existing runtime findings easier to locate without changing the empirical evidence. The incomplete assertion in Figure 7 limits the code listing's usability, but the corrections and explanatory gains support a modest overall improvement.
